inputs: ASX announcement title/source metadata when already available
strong row anchors such as Appendix line numbers and statement titles

signals: Appendix 4E when paired with full-year result language
types.extraction_policy: Select formal annual statement tables only in comparator artifacts; do not write canonical truth.
evidence_requirements: source title or first page proves annual/full-year report
currency and scale are explicit or deterministically detected
metric values bind to statement/table/page/row/column evidence

types.extraction_policy: Select Appendix 4D key-information rows plus formal interim statements as read-only candidates.
abstain_conditions: mixed announcement without formal statement pages
Appendix 4D title but missing numeric table anchors
metric appears only in narrative without table binding

signals: cash and cash equivalents at end of period
types.extraction_policy: Cashflow-only candidate artifacts. Income-statement and balance-sheet metrics remain expected-null unless separately explicit.
evidence_requirements: Appendix 4C title or equivalent listing-rule anchor
abstain_conditions: receipts row proposed as accrual revenue
line labels cannot be mapped deterministically

signals: results for announcement to the market
types.extraction_policy: Use Appendix 4D summary rows as candidates when they agree with formal interim statements or when row evidence is explicit and schema-supported.
evidence_requirements: explicit row labels for revenue/NPAT/cashflow statement metrics

signals: results for announcement to the market
types.extraction_policy: Use 4E summary and annual statements as read-only candidates, with formal statement table evidence preferred.
abstain_conditions: conflicting annual vs half-year period signals

signals: mining exploration entity or oil and gas exploration entity quarterly cash flow report
line 1.9 net cash from operating activities
types.extraction_policy: Line-item cashflow candidate artifacts only. Current-quarter and YTD columns must remain distinct. Do not map cash receipts to revenue.
abstain_conditions: line item crosses page without deterministic row continuation

types.extraction_policy: Default to abstain for deterministic parser artifacts unless formal statement or Appendix anchors are present.
evidence_requirements: source title or first-page text identifies non-statement announcement
absence of formal Appendix/statement anchors is recorded
abstain_conditions: all normal cases unless a later task proves a precise document subtype
